verdict.rationale: Docs confirm GDPR-oriented deletion and retrieval APIs and an EU Data Residency Program for storing/processing personal data, giving customers some control over retention and deletion, but there is no detail on self-service retention windows, automated deletion schedules, or how an 'AI-native' user (e.g., via the MCP server) would invoke these controls. Missing for 10: documented retention period settings/policies, independent verification that deletion requests are honored, and MCP/agent-accessible deletion tooling.
